text: 我是上海市西南位于中学的高子馨老师今天你会开始学习第一阶段试试新的东西请把你的学生书、工作室和笔记准备好你会学习第一阶段吗你会学习第一阶段吗你会学习第一阶段吗我会学习第一阶段吗我会学习第一阶段吗Yes, Wang Yiming wants to try something new, like enjoying new music, cooking a new dish.Young students are always interested in trying new things.What about you?Are there things you also want to try, or any other things that interest you?I want to try a different route to school.I'm tired of seeing the same view.It's boring.Why not?A new route may probably bring you a new experience.Here are some pictures showing different new things.What are they?Are they new to you?Would you like to try these activities?Can you match the pictures with the phrases?Please complete task one in your worksheet.Have you finished?Here are the correct answers.Picture one is a different route to school.Picture one is a talk light.Do you know what a talk light is?Yes, it's a light that talks.So, a talk light is a phrase that gives us a new idea.In English, we sometimes put two words together to create a new idea, a new word.We call it compound.Compound words help us expand our vocabulary.They're usually easy to understand.Can you find out any other compounds here?Right.Winged surfing, roof gardening, rock climbing, and fruit animals are all compounds.Among these activities, what are they?Among these activities, which one is new to you that you would like to try?Winged surfing is new to me.I never tried it before, and I am curious how to balance my body on a board.John is curious about the new sport.Curious here means 好奇的。Please read after me.Curious.What about you, Emily?Acting and the play is new to me.I am usually the quiet type, so I never join clubs like this.I think it will be a challenge to me.Even though it is a challenge, I think it is worth trying.Challenge here means 挑战。Challenge.As for me, rock climbing is a challenge.Yiming also finds these activities interesting, and he wants to share his findings with his teacher Ms.Chen and his friends.Listen to the conversation and answer the questions.Ready?Let's go.What new things do you find recently, Yiming?I find a wonderful sport called rock climbing.People use their arms and legs to climb up the rock wall.They are so brave.You like challenges, don't you?Great.What about you, Lu Yao?What do you find?I find a new machine in our school.It's called talk light.It is like a traffic light, except it turns green when we're quiet and red when we're too loud.I'm very curious about how it works.I think you need to learn more about light and sound.I will.Wonderful.What new things do you find, Ling Dong?I find something very interesting.I call it vegetable animals.There are animals made with vegetables.I first saw a photo on the Internet, and I want to create my own.It looks fun.Amazing.I'm looking forward to your creative vegetable animals.What are they talking about, Louis?They are talking about new things the students find recently.Excellent.How did you find out the answer?At the beginning of the conversation, Ms.Chen asked Yingming,What new things do you find recently?And then she repeats the question several times.Let's listen to the conversation again and finish task two in your worksheet.What new things do you find recently,Yingming?Who wants to tell us how many people there are in the conversation and who they are?There are four people in the conversation.There are Ms.Chen, Yiming, Lu Yao and Ling Dong.Well done.What new things do the students find?A talk light, rock climbing and vegetable animals.Great job.Where do the students find the new things?Lu Yao finds a talk light in the school.Ling Dong finds vegetable animals on the Internet.But Yiming doesn't say where he finds rock climbing.Exactly.From the conversation, we can also know some more detailed information about the new things.Why don't we listen to the conversation again and find it out?Please finish task three in your worksheet.Take notes while you're listening.They are animals made with vegetables.What did Yiming say about rock climbing?And Yiming thinks people are brave.Thank you, Emily.Do you have the answers for talk light?This one is a little tricky.Read the sentence.I'm sure you heard this sentence.It turns green when we're quiet and red when we're too loud.So it changes with the yes sound.Yes, sound.And Lu Yao is very curious about it.And for the next blank, here crafts refer to vegetable animals in the conversation.Ling Dong finds vegetable animals creative.He thinks the activity is great fun.Now let's take a look at the completed table.What are these facts about?Yiming tells us the skill people will learn from rock climbing.Lu Yao tells us the function about a talk light.And Ling Dong introduces the feature of vegetable animals.When you are introducing something new to your friends,you can include information like its skill, function and featureso that your friends will know more about it.Don't forget to include your own feelings towards new things.You may have your own likes or reasons.Have you found any new things?For example, I like to run in my neighborhood.I find that people are building a new path for joggers in my neighborhood.I discovered a new sport during PE class and I'm curious about how to play it.I am interested in cooking and I found my school offers cooking classesand I really want to take them next time.I tried a new musical instrument last weekand it is different from all the instruments I played before.Good.I'm sure that all of you have something new to share with us.I would like you to work in pairs and share your discovery with your partner.What should you include in your introduction besides the names of new things?Yes, facts about new things like skills needed, functions or features.What else?I will tell the class how I feel about the new thing.Right, the feelings.I will tell the class where I discovered the new thing.Very good, places.When you listen to your partner's talk,you can use the table under task 4 in your worksheet to take some notes.Now you may start sharing.Any interesting introductions?Thank you, William.Do you find Jessie's new discovery interesting?Well, I do.Jessie, can you share your notes on William's find with us?This is what I wrote down.William has talked about the soccer team in our school.Players on the team practice their skills in shooting at speed.Teamwork and communication is also needed for this sport.William is good at playing soccer, but he still thinks the school soccer team is challenging.Thank you guys for sharing.Very detailed introduction.Once we discover new things in our daily life, what do we do next?We try, because you never know what you can do until you try.For your homework,1.Finish exercise A workbook pages 2 to 3.Translate the given sentences into English.That's it for today's class.See you next time.Thank you for watching.
